claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is unlikely to kill cells through GABA/GLYC receptor antagonism; any observed killing would most plausibly reflect a non-selective cytotoxic or physicochemical effect rather than a receptor-mediated mechanism.
